card.name: Start of a numeric range
card.fires_on: The last digit of the first number in a numeric range, just before 'to' or a dash, such as 'range 1<<0>> to 47 days' or 'GFR 3<<0>> to 59'. It is common in ranges of days, doses, kidney function and temperature.

modes.label: Range of days or times
modes.description: Lower bound of a duration or time range in trial results.

modes.label: Range of lab or kidney values
modes.description: Lower bound of a creatinine clearance, GFR or temperature range.

card.writes: It promotes the word 'to' as the next word, which completes a range.
card.plain: It marks the first number of a range like '10 to 47', where 'to' comes next.
